title: Moscow Game Week Returns With Global Studios and Ranked CS2 Finals
content:
Moscow International Game Week will return for its second edition from October 29 to November 1, 2026, combining an international games exhibition, industry discussions and the Moscow Cyber Games Counter-Strike 2 LAN finals. Organisers say more than 85 companies will exhibit, with participants from India, Brazil, China, South Korea and Malaysia among those announced.

The official event schedule separates the wider city programme from the main venue activities. City events begin on October 29, while the gaming exhibition and business programme run from October 30 to November 1. The main venue is Moscow Game Hub, identified on the website as the Video Games and Animation Cluster at 40 Bolshoy Boulevard.

The announced overseas exhibitors include Brazil’s national stand, Brasilia Game Hub, China’s Chingmu, South Korean companies BURNING SOUL and BEAR&SKUNK, and Malaysia’s Experimental Design Team. India will have a group stand featuring BuzzedMen Studio, AbracaDabra Software Solutions and Nilee Games. Together, the exhibitors cover game development, creative services and technology used in production.

Russian publishers and gaming platforms will also present their work. An indie alley will bring together independent projects, while a separate residents’ alley will feature studios based at Moscow Game Hub. According to the organisers’ announcement, visitors will be able to try games, meet their creators and learn about game and animation development. A themed merchandise marketplace is also planned.

This year’s theme, “Beyond the Industry,” focuses on the relationship between games, animation, film and literature. Discussions will examine how creators can develop fictional worlds across different formats and find partners for new projects. The programme is intended for developers, investors and professionals working in related creative fields, alongside the exhibition’s public audience.

The published business tracks cover cultural identity in game design, business development and government support, shared fictional universes, education and AI in animation. Training, internships and practical experience are included in the education strand. The agenda therefore extends from producing individual games to building studios and developing stories that can support several kinds of media.

title: South Korea’s Culture Ministry Outlines Gaming Support
content:
South Korea’s culture ministry plans to support major game development, independent studios and training for an industry adapting to AI. Culture, Sports and Tourism Minister Choi Hwi-young outlined those priorities during an October 23 parliamentary audit, acknowledging slowing growth and pressure from Chinese competitors.

According to Inven Global , he said support had been reflected in next year’s budget plans. The ministry’s published proposals show where that support would go. Its 2027 budget outline includes 43.9 billion won for game planning and production programmes covering Global Frontier projects, indie titles and other initiatives.

The proposal also places games within a wider content-industry funding programme, linking support for individual productions with the government’s broader cultural-sector ambitions.

The ministry’s 2027 budget document shows a 10.5 billion won increase for the game planning and production category. Its overall proposed content-sector budget is 1.7719 trillion won. The 43.9 billion won figure covers the specified production-support category, rather than the government’s entire gaming budget. It remains a proposed allocation, with individual awards and delivery requiring separate implementation.

At an October 20 advisory meeting, Choi gave further details of the intended support. Yonhap reported that the new Global Frontier production-support programme had been allocated 6 billion won in the proposal. Planned indie creation funding would increase from 9.3 billion won to 13.8 billion won. The ministry’s announcement of that meeting also identified young talent as a priority alongside flagship projects and independent games.

During the parliamentary audit, Choi also described preparations for training and practical experience as AI changes game production. That places workforce development alongside financial support for studios.

title: Des matchs suspects en LFL ? Riot Games suspend un joueur de TLN Pirates
content:
Riot Games a annoncé ce jeudi la suspension provisoire de Tomislav « Thomas » Nanjara, support de TLN Pirates en LFL. Dans un communiqué officiel, l’éditeur de League of Legends explique avoir été informé de possibles infractions à son Code de conduite mondial de l’esport. Après un premier examen des éléments disponibles, Riot a décidé de prendre cette mesure conservatoire, entrée en vigueur le 22 octobre, le temps de poursuivre ses investigations. Cette suspension ne constitue toutefois pas une reconnaissance de culpabilité, précise l’éditeur. Le joueur pourra présenter sa version des faits avant toute décision définitive.

De son côté, TLN Pirates a également publié un communiqué pour expliquer la situation. L’organisation affirme avoir découvert des informations « susceptibles de remettre en cause l’intégrité compétitive de certains matchs disputés par notre équipe en LFL » . Elle indique avoir immédiatement pris contact avec Riot Games afin de transmettre les éléments en sa possession. Une enquête a depuis été ouverte, à laquelle la structure assure coopérer pleinement.

Dans l’attente des conclusions, TLN Pirates confirme que des mesures conservatoires ont été prises au sein de son effectif, sans donner davantage de précisions. Le club explique vouloir préserver la confidentialité de l’enquête et les droits des personnes concernées. Riot Games n’a pas non plus détaillé la nature exacte des faits reprochés. La suspension de Thomas restera en vigueur jusqu’à la conclusion de l’enquête ou jusqu’à nouvel ordre, mais pourra être levée si les éléments recueillis ne justifient pas de nouvelles mesures.

title: RLCS : la Karmine Corp va reconstruire autour de M0nkey M00n

Plusieurs autres pistes avaient été étudiées, notamment prozy, finalement attendu chez Ninjas in Pyjamas, et l’ancien joueur de Gentle Mates yujin.

Double champion du monde et finaliste du Major de Paris avec Twisted Minds, M0nkey M00n devrait ainsi retrouver l’Europe après une saison passée dans la région MENA. Le Français de 23 ans, longtemps adversaire de la Karmine Corp sous les couleurs de BDS et Vitality, apporterait son expérience à deux joueurs encore peu habitués au plus haut niveau. Bibbaba s’est notamment illustré en atteignant le top 6 des qualifications européennes de la dernière chance pour les Worlds 2026, tandis que reyyn, spécialiste du 1v1, n’a encore jamais disputé de compétition RLCS.

Ce recrutement marquerait également un changement de stratégie important pour la Karmine Corp, qui avait sérieusement envisagé de se retirer de Rocket League après avoir perdu la bataille pour conserver Atow et Vatira. Kameto avait alors évoqué deux possibilités : recruter des joueurs confirmés encore disponibles ou repartir avec de très jeunes talents. Avec M0nkey M00n, bibbaba et reyyn, le club semble finalement avoir choisi de combiner les deux approches. Un pari ambitieux pour une équipe qui devra désormais se reconstruire autour d’une légende de la scène française et de deux espoirs prometteurs.

content:
Orangutan aren’t breaking up their BGMI lineup. Founder Yash Bhanushali shut down the rumours on October 23, saying there will be “NO changes” and that every player is signed on a long-term contract ending in 2029.

title: LEC : Razork a choisi Heretics
content:
Après cinq saisons sous les couleurs de Fnatic, Iván « Razork » Martín Díaz aurait trouvé sa prochaine destination. D’après les informations de Sheep Esports , le joueur de 26 ans est sur le point de s’engager pour une saison avec Team Heretics. Également associé à GIANTX ces dernières semaines, Razork aurait donc privilégié le projet de Heretics, qui avait déjà tenté de le recruter l’année dernière. À l’époque, les deux organisations étaient parvenues à un accord concernant son transfert, mais les négociations avec le joueur n’avaient pas abouti. Cette fois, la présence de Jackies et Jun aurait notamment pesé dans la balance. Le jungler retrouverait ainsi le support coréen, son ancien partenaire chez Fnatic en 2024, avec lequel il avait disputé trois finales du LEC, toutes perdues face à G2 Esports.

Avec cette arrivée, Team Heretics serait la première équipe du LEC à avoir bouclé trois recrues pour 2027. L’organisation espagnole, qui avait également étudié la piste Lyncas, semble déterminée à construire un effectif compétitif après une saison décevante. Razork devrait prendre la place de Daglas, toujours sous contrat jusqu’en 2027 mais écarté des plans de l’équipe première. De son côté, Shopify Rebellion avait également manifesté son intérêt pour l’Espagnol, qui a finalement choisi de poursuivre sa carrière en Europe.

Pour Fnatic, ce départ marque le début d’une importante reconstruction. Après avoir participé à tous les Worlds depuis son arrivée en 2022, Razork a connu une saison 2026 particulièrement compliquée, conclue sans qualification pour le championnat du monde. Fnatic a terminé huitième du Winter Split, puis septième au printemps et en été. Avec la quasi-totalité de son effectif en fin de contrat, à l’exception de Lospa, la structure britannique pourrait profondément remanier son équipe. Quant à Razork, il tentera de relancer sa carrière chez Heretics, avec toujours le même objectif : décrocher enfin son premier titre de champion du LEC.

title: How to Play Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer Early With the New Zealand Trick
content:
You can play Modern Warfare 4 multiplayer early on console by switching your region to New Zealand. Console multiplayer unlocks at midnight local time on October 23, and New Zealand reaches midnight before anyone else, at 11:00 UTC on October 22. On the US East Coast, that works out to a 17-hour head start.

The trick works best on Xbox and through the Xbox app on PC. Steam and Battle.net players are out of luck because PC unlocks at one moment worldwide. PlayStation is possible, but it costs you a second account.

Console players get multiplayer at 12:00 AM local time on October 23. New Zealand has been on daylight saving time (NZDT, UTC+13) since late September, which is why its midnight lands at 11:00 UTC on October 22.

Some guides list the New Zealand unlock as 6:00 AM on October 21. That is wrong. The table below shows what time New Zealand’s unlock hits in your zone, and how many hours you gain over waiting for your own midnight.

The math favours the Americas. A player in Los Angeles can be ten matches deep before most of the US has even woken up.

title: CS2 October 22 Update Opens Hostages, Game Rules and Console to Map Scripts
content:
Valve released a Counter-Strike 2 update on October 22, 2026, and every line of it is for mapmakers. Map scripts can now track hostages, control warmup, scores and round endings through a new GameRules export, run console commands and preload assets. Competitive matchmaking, weapons and maps are unchanged.

The other big addition is a top-level Console export that can set convars without sv_cheats turned on. Radar elements placed by scripts also work in every game mode now. Before this patch they only showed up in Rush.

Valve’s official October 22 patch notes on Steam are split almost entirely under a map scripting header. Six areas moved. Hostages, precaching, the console, game rules, the custom HUD and the radar each picked up new functions, and a short list of fixes closed it out.

For anyone keeping track, this is the second patch in eight days. The previous one, on October 14, was a quality-of-life pass on demos, and we covered it in our breakdown of the CS2 demo viewer and round backup changes .

These are Valve’s official release notes for the October 22, 2026 Counter-Strike 2 update.

Hostage Rescue has been part of Counter-Strike since the late 1990s, yet scripts in CS2 couldn’t see it until now. The new CSHostage class exposes whether a hostage is being picked up, being carried, or already rescued. It can also return the player who rescued it, plus the exact start and finish times of a pickup.

title: Gears of War: E-Day Reportedly Cost Over $500 Million, and Its Finished PS5 Version Never Shipped
content:
Gears of War: E-Day cost Microsoft more than $500 million to make, according to a new report , and that figure leaves out marketing. The claim surfaced on October 22, two weeks after the game launched as an Xbox console exclusive. Microsoft has not commented.

If the number holds, E-Day sits among the most expensive games ever made. It also puts fresh weight on a question fans have asked since June: why would Xbox shelve a PS5 version that was reportedly already finished?

Kotaku’s number comes from one “source familiar with Xbox’s business,” who said spending “was over $500 million, and that’s before you include marketing.” Kotaku and Forbes both asked Microsoft for comment. Neither got an answer.

Chris Dring of The Game Business backed the figure in public, saying that from what he’d been told it was “very true.” For scale, Insomniac’s Marvel’s Spider-Man 2 cost roughly $300 million, a number that only came out through the studio’s 2023 data leak.

Work on E-Day began around 2020 at The Coalition, a Vancouver studio of about 300 people, with People Can Fly helping on development. Six years of AAA production at that headcount adds up fast.

Not everyone accepts the figure. Back in June, Insider Gaming’s Tom Henderson said he’d heard the game cost “upwards of $400 million,” and Jez Corden of Windows Central pushed back hard.

title: Beginning to play CS2 in 2026? Here’s all you need to know
content:
Counter-Strike 2 is one of the most-played games on the planet, and one of the easiest to hear about without ever understanding. It is free. It is Valve’s tactical shooter, and under one name or another it has anchored competitive PC gaming for over two decades.

Maybe you have watched a clip, or seen a friend chase a knife worth more than their monitor, or you just want to know what the fuss is about. Either way, here is the lay of the land, from the esports down to the cosmetics.

CS2 is a five-versus-five tactical shooter, released in 2023 as the successor to the long-running CS:GO. One team tries to plant a bomb. The other defends the two bombsites and races to defuse it. Win enough rounds and you take the match, and the teams swap attack and defence at the halfway mark.

There is no respawning inside a round, so a single mistake can end it for you. Money matters too. Before each round you buy guns and armour with cash earned from the last one, so a losing streak starves you of firepower. Skill is earned through aim and positioning, never unlocked with playtime. That is the whole appeal: free to load up, brutally hard to master.

This is where plenty of newcomers arrive first. CS2 has one of the largest esports scenes in the world. Valve runs the showpiece Majors, third parties fill the rest of the calendar, and the prize money is real: the best players have banked more than two million dollars in career winnings.

Teams like Vitality and Spirit sell out arenas, and names like ZywOo, s1mple and the teenage phenomenon donk carry the sort of following footballers do. Best of all, you can watch nearly all of it free, on Twitch and YouTube, in dozens of languages, most weekends of the year. You do not need to play a single round to enjoy it. The tension of a one-versus-one with the bomb ticking needs no translation. The biggest finals pull in millions of concurrent viewers online.

title: Capcom details CAPCOM ID incident: Gameplay unaffected, 196 passwords reset

Capcom has confirmed only its second ever major security breach, sharing on Oct. 22 that a third party gained unauthorized access to CAPCOM ID, its unified account service, exposing 11,774,247 records worldwide. Services that use the login still work, Capcom says no credit card information was involved but 43 accounts had personal information exposed, including their date of birth. 196 accounts also had their passwords changed by the attacker.

CAPCOM ID is the single account used across Capcom's web services and select online games, including Street Fighter 6 . Anyone who plays or registers on those services holds one, and while some sources claim only Japanese accounts have been affected by this breach, others say it’s a global issue.

title: Is Japan the Weakest Region at BMIC 2026? A Look at Its International Performances
content:
Japan is one of the most established regions in PUBG Mobile esports, but its recent international performances have raised questions ahead of the BGMI International Cup (BMIC) 2026 . The tournament will take place from October 30 to November 1 in Mumbai, featuring six Indian teams, five South Korean teams, and five Japanese teams.

South Korea has been one of the strongest regions in international PUBG Mobile competitions, while Indian teams have recently started delivering better results on the global stage. However, Japan has struggled in several major tournaments over the past few years. Does this make Japan the weakest region heading into BMIC 2026? Let’s look at the results.

Japan has a long history in PUBG Mobile esports, with organisations like REJECT representing the country internationally. REJECT, which featured popular players such as SaRa and Reiji, won the PUBG Mobile Global Open (PMGO) 2024. It remains Japan’s only major global PUBG Mobile championship title.

However, the region has struggled to repeat that success. At BMIC 2025, REJECT finished at the bottom of the standings despite entering the tournament with high expectations. CAG Osaka was Japan’s best-performing team, finishing third after a strong comeback on the final day. Apart from CAG Osaka, the other three Japanese teams finished among the bottom five. While South Korean teams fought for the championship and Indian teams delivered competitive performances, most Japanese teams struggled throughout the tournament.

Japan’s struggles were also visible at the PUBG Mobile World Cup (PMWC). At PMWC 2026, Japan was represented by DOPENESS, which qualified after winning the Japanese league. However, the team struggled in the Group Stage and finished 13th, narrowly advancing to the Survival Stage. DOPENESS then finished 11th in the Survival Stage and was eliminated, ending its World Cup campaign in 21st place overall. In comparison, both Indian teams qualified for the PMWC 2026 Grand Finals.

Japan also struggled at PMWC 2025. KINOTROPE represented the region with a roster that included two South Korean players. Despite having international experience in the lineup, the team finished 23rd, or second-last, in the tournament. The situation was similar at the PUBG Mobile Global Championship (PMGC) 2025, where REJECT finished 37th overall.

title: Interview with Tencent: How esports technology shapes the future of competition in Asia
content:
The 2026 Asian Games recently concluded in Japan’s Aichi-Nagoya, and what made the competition interesting was the Olympic Council of Asia’s (OCA) inclusion of esports as an official medal event. Players duked it out in titles such as League of Legends, Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB), Street Fighter 6, TEKKEN 8, and more. Tencent Esports, the official technology partner of the OCA, sat down for an exclusive interview with esports.gg.

We spoke with Teri Zhang, senior director of Tencent’s esports business department and esports manager at the OCA, about esports’ evolution as a recognized sport, the impact of technology, and the future of competitive gaming in Asia.

Esports as a medal event is not new to the Asian Games since it first appeared in 2018 as a demonstration before the OCA added it to the 2026 Games calendar in 2023. Despite uncertainty over its inclusion in late 2024, the OCA approved the final lineup in 2025. Asian Games 2026 then featured 13 video game titles across 11 medal events.

In her interview with esports.gg, Zhang shared how this continued inclusion of esports at the Asian Games shows its growing role in the region. This growth also shifts the focus from proving that esports belongs in major sporting events to running competitions fairly and consistently at scale.

“The conversation has evolved beyond whether esports belongs at the Asian Games. The focus today is on how esports can be successfully integrated into a multi-sport environment at scale,” Zhang said, adding that the OCA must manage six competitive categories, different gaming devices, technical requirements, and more at an unprecedented level.

“In that sense, the Asian Games serves as a milestone for esports and an opportunity to strengthen the foundations that will support its long-term development,” she continued. “It allows the industry to refine competition processes, technical standards, and review mechanisms that can be applied consistently across future events.”

title: All Police Station locations in Modern Warfare 4 DMZ

title: How to find and open a Safe in Modern Warfare 4 DMZ
content:
Throughout your career in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ, you’ll continually get to complete DMZ Orders, which are specific tasks that earn you rewards the more you complete them. While some of the DMZ Orders are simple, others can be rather difficult, and one of the more challenging ones is to “Open a Safe.”

While this sounds trivial at first glance, you then realize that Safes aren’t too common to find on the Hajin map in DMZ. Luckily, though, we know of some dedicated spots for Safes that allow you to complete this DMZ Order with no problem at all.

For us, this specific DMZ Order was on Page 5, and it even says that you can find Safes in Compounds and Locked Spaces . Of course, that doesn’t help a lot, as you still need to go out and search for these locations and then locate the Safe itself.

While you might have some serious trouble trying to find a “Locked Space,” you shouldn’t have many problems locating a Compound. These are marked by a tent icon on your Tac-Map and are fairly common in Hajin, particularly out in the woodlands or the side roads in between the major points of interest on the map.

In order to open a Safe in a Compound, you need to enter it and then clear out 100% of the enemy AI from the area . This is tracked by a percentage meter that appears on the left side of your screen when you enter a Compound. There are usually around 10-12 enemies in each Compound, and when they’re all cleared out, your meter will read 100%.

From here, you need to find the Safe that the Compound has stashed. For the most part, the Safe is located at the top of the guard tower, which is found at most Compounds . Just climb the stairs to get to the top, and you’ll find the Safe sitting on the ground next to a desk. Interact with it, loot the contents, and you’ll get a mission completion for this DMZ Order.

title: PHP Flaw Is Taking Gaming and Esports Websites Offline
content:
Two critical security flaws in PHP, the code behind most of the web, pushed hundreds of websites offline on Wednesday, October 21. Gaming and esports sites are caught up in it too, with esports wiki Liquipedia among those down for users. PHP released a fix at about 13:45 UTC (7:15 PM IST), but every site still has to install it.

The bugs, nicknamed PHP2Shell, could let attackers run their own code on a website’s server without logging in. Security agencies in Europe, the UK, Australia and Japan told site owners to patch at once or go offline until they could.

If a gaming wiki, forum or fan site you use is down today, this is the most likely reason. Expect some sites to keep flickering for the next day or two

On Tuesday evening, PHP’s security team gave advance notice of two critical bugs and a fix scheduled for 14:00 UTC Wednesday. Details had already leaked, and Cloudflare said it was seeing attack attempts.

The EU’s cyber response team, CERT-EU, then told organisations that couldn’t patch quickly to consider pulling sites offline. Agencies in the UK, Australia, Japan, Germany and the Netherlands issued similar warnings, as The Record reported .

Many listened. The Dutch parliament, government portals in Finland and France and even the Dutch cyber security centre’s own site went dark as a precaution.

title: Evil Geniuses shuts down after seven years from unsuccesful reacquisition
content:
The storied American organization follows in the footsteps of its competitor, Complexity.

Evil Geniuses, stories American esports organization, has announced the cessation of operations effective on November 6th, 2026.

The organization posted a statement by their CEO, Chris DeAppolonio, describing their effort to “stabilize operations and restore public sentiment”, ultimately succumbing to the “headwinds” of esports, including “limited sponsorships and the rising cost of competing at the top level.”

Evil Geniuses started as a Quake team in 1999, and went onto be household names in top esports such as Counter-Strike 1.6 until 2012 and Dota 2, notably winning The International in 2015.

Evil Geniuses was presided by Alex Garfield since 2004, who was a pioneer in creating sponsorship deals in esports. After being acquired by Twitch in 2014, Evil Geniuses was threatened with a boycott from other organizations due to a potential conflict of interest, impacting their ability to compete.

Evil Geniuses shifted to becoming a player-owned organization in 2016, until finally being bought by the American investment firm, PEAK6, in 2019. Under the leadership of Nicole LaPointe Jameson, Evil Geniuses initially had strong results, acquiring NRG’s Counter-Strike team that would win the final edition ESL One New York in 2019.

The stakes for Wolves are high. The team is one of four current VCT China partners to lose partner status for 2027-2028, Sheep Esports reported. FunPlus Phoenix, Nova Esports and Titan Esports Club are the other three. China drops from ten partners to eight for that cycle.

Threshold now offers the club a way back. The event is the last of China’s Nationals season and replaces Valorant Challengers there. It follows the old Ascension format. Two teams then join VCT China as 2027 guest teams.

Thirteen teams are playing at THE HUB Performing Arts Center in Shanghai. They come from VCT China and the China National Tournament. Week 1 is a single-elimination bracket of five VCT China teams and seven national teams. Its winner earns a 2027 VCT China place.

Defeat does not end a team’s hopes. Losers move into a Week 2 single-elimination playoff, where one more national team joins them. Week 1 runs from 21 to 25 October. Week 2 follows from 27 October to 1 November.

title: Cloud9, FURIA, KOI… qui va quitter VALORANT en 2027 ?
content:
La réduction du nombre d’équipes partenaires, de dix à huit par région, laisse plusieurs grands noms sur le carreau. En Amériques, Cloud9, FURIA, ENVY, M80, FlyQuest, Shopify Rebellion et LYON n’ont pas été retenus, tandis que Movistar KOI, GIANTX, Barça eSports et Eternal Fire connaissent le même sort en EMEA. Dans le Pacifique, Nongshim RedForce et DRX perdent également leur statut, malgré des résultats marquants ces dernières saisons. Vainqueur du Masters Santiago en 2026, Nongshim fait notamment partie des grandes surprises de cette sélection. Mais perdre son partenariat ne signifie pas nécessairement quitter la compétition.

Nongshim RedForce, DRX, Barça eSports et Eternal Fire ont également annoncé leur intention de poursuivre l’aventure. En revanche, l’incertitude demeure pour FURIA, Movistar KOI, GIANTX, ENVY, M80 ou encore FlyQuest, qui n’ont pas encore confirmé leur participation à la saison 2027. Plusieurs structures préfèrent attendre d’en savoir davantage sur les nouvelles conditions du circuit avant de prendre une décision.

Pour d’autres, le verdict est déjà tombé. Global Esports, S8UL Esports, RIDDLE et FOKUS ont annoncé leur départ de la scène compétitive VALORANT. Le cas de Global Esports est particulièrement marquant : quelques semaines après avoir remporté le Stage 2 du VCT Pacific, l’organisation a décidé de mettre fin à ses activités esportives pour se concentrer sur d’autres projets. Les équipes souhaitant continuer auront toutefois une porte d’entrée vers l’élite : dès novembre, des qualifications ouvertes permettront de décrocher quatre places supplémentaires aux côtés des huit partenaires lors du Kickoff 2027, organisé du 14 janvier au 7 février. title: Evil Geniuses to end esports era after 27 years
content:
Esports organization Evil Geniuses just announced the end of its esports operations. The news arrived on the evening of Oct. 20, which also revealed that Evil Geniuses will shut down on Nov. 2.

Evil Geniuses will cease its competitive and day-to-day operations on Nov. 2. According to the organization’s CEO Chris DeAppolonio, the esports industry continues to face significant challenges, including limited sponsorship opportunities and rising competition costs. Despite efforts to rebuild the organization, it can no longer operate sustainably .

“Unfortunately, esports continues to face significant headwinds, including limited sponsorship and the rising cost of competing at the top level,” DeAppolonio explained. “Despite sustained investment and the dedication of the EG team, it’s been concluded that the business cannot be operated responsibly in the current environment.”

Therefore, Evil Geniuses will shut down its operations.

All players on Evil Geniuses’ esports rosters can now freely contact other organizations. Its VALORANT players and coaches will also be able to sign with new teams after the end of the 2026 season on Nov. 2.

“To the players, the staff, and everyone who put their heart and soul into EG over the last few years: you were all amazing,” DeAppolonio stated. “We gave this organization everything we had. I could not have asked for a better team. To everyone who has ever worn the EG logo, to the fans who kept showing up, and to the partners who supported this org over the last 25+ years: thank you for everything.”

title: WoW Forever interview: Michael Nuthals on bringing the magic of 2004 Azeroth into 2026
content:
World of Warcraft: Forever (WoW Forever) launches on Nov. 4, but Blizzard Entertainment is celebrating with the community ahead of time through the WoW Forever: Escape Together event. Esports.gg was invited to the event, which challenged participants to solve puzzles and escape the Scarlet Monastery in Toronto. We also sat down with lead encounter designer Michael Nuthals there to talk about WoW Forever’s dungeons, raid content, and how the team approached the reimagined Azeroth.

In his interview with esports.gg, Nuthals shared how his team wants to balance the spirit of Classic WoW with the expectations of modern WoW. This involves gathering player feedback from platforms like YouTube and Reddit plus looking at internal data. The team especially wants the encounter side of dungeons to feel right. Therefore, they also pay close attention to the original game’s design philosophy and compare its dungeons with their WoW Forever counterparts. Examples include Deadmines and the Ruins of Lordaeron .

“We want to make sure that those newer dungeons feel like they sit next to those original experiences,” Nuthals said. “You know, one thing when I started on the Forever team is we just started playing a ton of Classic. Every Thursday morning, the encounter team would grab the reference client for the Era servers and we would be like, ‘Let’s play Deadmines.’ And we would go through Deadmines. And then we go, ‘Okay, let’s run it in Forever. How does it feel?’ We want to make sure we’re getting that same vibe.”

The Riverglades zone is another example of how WoW Forever recaptures the magic of 2004 Azeroth. Nuthals told us that he’s quite proud of this particular zone in WoW Forever, which has that Classic feeling yet uses new rendering technology involving fog.

“Honestly, I’m proud of everything the team has put out — all of the different experiences our players are going to have. I really love the Riverglades. The Riverglades is a zone most players haven’t had a chance to really dive into yet, but it is a zone that just feels like it popped out of 2004, and it has that really Classic vibe,” Nuthals told esports.gg. “I love our new rendering technology — with the fog and the draw distances and the lighting. It’s just almost magical to come riding on your horse through the Riverglades.”

He continued, adding that from the encounter side of things, he’s really looking forward to players getting into the Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit raids slated for December 2026.

title: Exclusive: Esports Charts founders on the past, present, and future of esports viewership analytics
content:
Esports Charts has become a household name in the industry for viewership data over its ten years of activity. esports.gg sat down with the founders of Esports Charts to tell the story of how they shot to relevance in the past decade, their tales along the way, and what they think of the next ten years of esports.

Esports Charts has crunched a lot of numbers over the decade. (Image credit: AWERTI) Ten years of Esports Charts: Esports Charts began as a three-person project in 2016, and the first event they covered was LoL Worlds 2016 . By 2017, its data became central to the discussion between fanbases online. By 2018 is when it “stopped being a niche product,” said its co-founder. Fnatic became the first esports organization to use Esports Charts for sponsors in the same year. Esports Charts called the mobile tide early, calling it the trend for 2018. In 2019, the team has grown to 20+ members, and would launch other products in the next few years including Streams Charts . COVID ushered in co-streamers and community casters, which remain a stalwart of esports broadcasts to this day. In present day, the AWERTI team are faced with the sheer volume of data generated. They process 60+ million channels on dozens of streaming platforms across multiple products. AI supports the development and analysis, but the team’s core values remain rooted in delivering trustworthy data . For the future, the team has its eyes on titles like VALORANT Mobile , Deadlock, Marvel Rivals, and Delta Force. The past: Esports Charts’ beginnings and growth as a company Currently, Esports Charts is a product that belongs to its parent company, AWERTI. It didn’t start out like that, though.

Artyom Odintsov , CEO and co-founder of AWERTI and its flagship products, Esports Charts and Streams Charts, revealed that it began as a three-person project between him, co-founder Ivan Danishevsky , and Chief Technical Officer (CTO) Ihor Kryvych .

“We didn’t have the positions separated like that at the beginning, but over the years our roles grew into these positions,” said Odintsov.

Even the products themselves weren’t set in stone. “We built many different things throughout the decade, and our need for the team changed accordingly. Before Esports Charts raised its seed round, AWERTI, then called ESM.one , launched a tournament platform for CS, Dota 2 and LoL , academies for Ukrainian streamers , the ZeerTV studio , and lots of other things.”

Over time, projects were sold to other companies, and the teams moved with the product. Within ESM.one, some projects were closed, and manpower was instead allocated to Esports Charts, then Streams Charts.

title: How to get the Tactical Nuke killstreak in Modern Warfare 4
content:
The most iconic killstreak in the entire Call of Duty franchise is the Tactical Nuke, and it’s confirmed to be returning in Modern Warfare 4 . Not only was the Nuke seen in a recent MW4 trailer, but we’ve also seen gameplay of the streak in a real match.

So, naturally, this has caused players everywhere to wonder: how do you get the Nuke in Modern Warfare 4? We’ll break the killstreak down for you in the guide below.

It’s been fully confirmed that the Tactical Nuke is an earnable killstreak in Modern Warfare 4. We’ve already seen players earn the Nuke, and you call it in very similarly to other games in the Modern Warfare franchise.

The Tactical Nuke is earned when you go on a 30 killstreak in MW4. Only gun, equipment, and Field Upgrade kills count towards this streak, so you can’t factor in kills from other killstreaks. When you go on a 30 streak, you’ll get a notification that you can call in the Nuke, which immediately ends the current match and wins the game for your team . You’ll then see a unique animation play out, including your character throwing up their middle finger while being blown away by the Nuke explosion.

Just like in every other Modern Warfare game, the Tactical Nuke isn’t a killstreak that you equip as part of your three core streaks . It’s a streak that’s active for all players at all times, so whenever you go on a 30 killstreak, you’ll earn the ability to call in the Nuke.

So there you have it: the Tactical Nuke is a killstreak in Modern Warfare 4, and it’s only earned once you hit a 30 killstreak with your gun or equipment. You can’t cheese the Nuke using killstreak kills like you could in the original MW2, so it’s very rare that you’ll earn or see a Nuke called in during a match of MW4.

title: All Weapon Prestige Camos in Modern Warfare 4 & how to earn them
content:
There are several different forms of progression in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 , and one of the newer grinds in multiplayer is earning Weapon Prestige Camos. This system was brought back to the franchise in Black Ops 7, and Modern Warfare 4 has kept it in multiplayer, but with some twists.

Weapon Prestige Camos can be earned across all 33 weapons in MW4, but there are only four of them in total to unlock. You unlock each camo the same way for all weapons, but, of course, you need to know the unlock method before you start the grind. Below, we’ll explain everything you need to know about earning Weapon Prestige Camos in MW4.

The four Weapon Prestige Camos in MW4 multiplayer are: Pyroclast, Pyroclast Terminus, Pyroclast Scatter, and Pyroclast Cascade. You won’t start the process of earning any of these camos until you reach Weapon Prestige 1 with a weapon. This is accomplished by getting to that weapon’s max level, which usually goes to around 65-70 for most primary weapons.

Once you reach the max level for a weapon, you can enter Weapon Prestige , which works the same way that Classic Prestige Mode works in MW4 . When you enter Weapon Prestige, you reset that weapon back to level one and re-lock any non-shared attachments for it. You keep all shared attachments, though. From this point, you can re-unlock all weapon levels, and when you reach max level again, you’ll start earning Weapon Prestige Master levels. There are then 250 total levels to max out Weapon Prestige Master .

You can only Prestige weapons a single time in MW4, but once you do, you can start unlocking Weapon Prestige Camos. Look below to find out what you need to do to unlock all four Weapon Prestige Camos in multiplayer:

Unlike in Black Ops 7, which has unique Weapon Prestige Camos for every single weapon, the four camos are the same for all weapons in Modern Warfare 4. So, just because you earn Pyroclast Cascade for the M4 doesn’t then mean you have it unlocked for the Patriot XMR. Every Weapon Prestige grind is separate, but the Weapon Prestige Camos are the same.

title: Best Permanent Unlocks to spend Tokens on in Modern Warfare 4
content:
Classic Prestige has returned in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, and that means that Permanent Unlock Tokens are coming back as well. If you’re unfamiliar with how Prestige Mode works, it resets your level back to one, but you receive a Permanent Unlock Token that you can use on any class item in multiplayer in exchange.

This is a huge benefit, as it lets you permanently unlock an item so you never have to unlock it again during the entire Prestige grind in Modern Warfare 4 . However, with so many items to choose from, which unlock gives you the best bang for your buck?

Below, we’ll give you five distinct class items in MW4 multiplayer that are most worth spending a Permanent Unlock Token on after you Prestige. The item list is in order from 1-5.

First on the list has to be the Stim, which is a piece of Tactical Equipment that quickly heals you back to full health when applied. The Stim is unlocked at level 47 in MW4 multiplayer, making it one of the final items you’ll unlock every single Prestige.

While there are other solid pieces of Tactical Equipment you can use until that level, once you get used to the Stim, there’s really no going back. The ability to get back into the fight instantly after being injured, compared to waiting for several seconds to recoup health, is one of the most important benefits of any item in multiplayer. If you use a Permanent Unlock Token on the Stim, your Tactical slot is pretty much set in stone on all loadouts in multiplayer.

Next up, we have the Axion assault rifle, which is unlocked at level 52. The Axion is one of the best assault rifles in Modern Warfare 4, and having it available for only three levels every Prestige is ultimately a waste of its potential. This is arguably a top meta weapon in multiplayer, so you’ll want it permanently unlocked as soon as possible.

title: How to level up weapons faster in Modern Warfare 4
content:
Weapon leveling is one of the core elements in any Call of Duty, but the 33 total weapons in Modern Warfare 4 have dozens of levels that you need to grind through. While it will take a long time before you reach max level with all weapons, or even your favorites, there are some key tips you can take advantage of to make the leveling process much less stressful. To see the best ways to level up your weapons quickly in Modern Warfare 4, keep reading the guide below.

We’ll lay out some distinct, fast weapon leveling methods for Modern Warfare 4, but they will mostly be tied to multiplayer.

It’s one of the most common ways to earn more XP in Call of Duty, but that’s because it simply works the best. While you can certainly get more overall XP by playing objective game modes, this also applies to weapon XP.

The more XP you earn during the course of a match, the more XP is applied to the weapon that you’re currently using. So, while kills still offer the most weapon XP possible, playing the objective and earning match score that way also grants you weapon XP.

The best objective modes to play if you want to earn weapon XP faster than any other method are Kill Confirmed, Hardpoint, and Domination , but the first two are going to be your best bets. When playing Kill Confirmed, make sure you’re picking up any dog tag possible for the max amount of XP, while in Hardpoint you want to continually attack the hill, getting kills in and around it for extra XP.

As long as you’re primarily using the weapon you want to level up fast in Modern Warfare 4, you’ll get a ton of regular and weapon XP in objective game modes.

What happens when you enter Prestige Mode in MW4? Explained
content:
Prestige Mode has officially returned in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 , but with an added twist. While Infinity Ward has brought back the Classic Prestige system that fans know and love, there’s also a new Prestige Mode that gives players some additional choice in how they reset their progress.

There are some major pros and cons to both of these Prestige Modes in Modern Warfare 4, along with key rewards that do change depending on which mode you pick. The biggest questions you might have, though, are what happens when you Prestige in MW4 and should you even bother Prestiging in multiplayer? We’ll answer both of those questions down below.

First off, you need to understand how Prestige Mode works in MW4, as it’s very different from previous years. It should be noted that multiplayer Prestige works totally separately from DMZ Prestige in MW4 , which is a whole other progression loop.

However, it starts the same as normal, as you have to work your way through 55 military levels before you get the option to enter Prestige Mode. Along these 55 levels, you’ll unlock every class item in multiplayer, including all weapons, perks, killstreaks, and equipment. Once you reach level 55 in multiplayer, you have three choices:

The new choice this year is Regular Prestige, which allows you to reset your level and earn a new Prestige Icon, but you keep all of your class items permanently unlocked. This allows you to keep earning XP and gaining new levels without having to re-unlock every item during a Prestige over and over again. However, the tradeoff for this decision is that you don’t earn every Prestige reward.

On the other hand, Classic Prestige works just like it has for the past two years. You reset your level and class unlocks and earn every single Prestige reward. You’ll also gain a 20% XP boost for the remainder of your account’s life and earn a Permanent Unlock Token, which can be used to permanently unlock one class item every Prestige.

title: Is Steam down right now? Server status and how to fix it

If you’re having trouble with getting into a game or accessing your library, then Steam may be down. If the issue is on Valve’s end, there isn’t much you can do except wait for Valve to resolve the problem or for Steam’s weekly maintenance to finish up.

Steam does maintenance every Tuesday between 12 p.m. PT and 3 p.m. PT. This scheduled maintenance usually takes about 10 to 30 minutes. Therefore, simply wait a bit to access your account and games again.

In general, if you’re ever experiencing some issues accessing Steam, then check the time and date. That’s because Steam does maintenance every Tuesday between 12 p.m. PT and 3 p.m. PT.

This scheduled maintenance usually takes about 10 to 30 minutes. Therefore, simply wait a bit to access your account and games again.

You can also visit the Downdetector website to see if other players are having the same issue. Once you’re on Downdetector, scroll down a bit to check out the outage reports. There’s also the option to submit your own Steam outage report.

title: GTA 6 Firings: Rockstar Union Tribunal Hears HR Gave Discord Informant Time Off
content:
Rockstar Games allegedly gave a staff member time off for watching a private union Discord server, according to evidence shown at the Rockstar union tribunal in Glasgow on October 16, 2026. The claim comes from the Independent Workers’ Union of Great Britain (IWGB), which represents the GTA 6 developers fired in 2025. Rockstar denies the firings had anything to do with union activity.

The evidence is a short message exchange. In it, a Rockstar HR manager lets an informant take an hour back after the worker spent an hour combing through the union server for screenshots.

Rockstar calls these people “whistleblowers.” The tribunal uses the neutral label “information providers,” and their names are redacted from the court papers.

The exchange was put to Rockstar executive Jennifer Kolbe during cross-examination, as first reported by Vertical Slice . The Scotsman describes Kolbe as the company’s second most senior person.

In the messages, HR manager Julie Stephen offers the informant extra time off as compensation. The worker had spent an hour “going through everything” on the union server and collecting screenshots.

The informant asked for an hour off the next day. Stephen allegedly replied “no worries,” and the request was approved in Workday.

title: LEC : la fin d’une époque chez Fnatic, Razork courtisé par deux rivaux
content:
L’aventure entre Iván « Razork » Martín et Fnatic semble toucher à sa fin. Arrivé en 2022, le jungler espagnol pourrait quitter l’organisation britannique après cinq années marquées par quatre finales du LEC, toutes perdues face à G2 Esports. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Team Heretics et GIANTX seraient désormais les deux principaux prétendants à sa signature. Les deux structures espagnoles auraient déjà formulé une offre au joueur, qui n’a pas encore arrêté son choix. Une décision pourrait intervenir dans les prochains jours.

Les deux équipes ont d’ailleurs commencé à préparer leur effectif pour 2027. Heretics aurait déjà trouvé des accords avec Jackies et Jun, et espère désormais attirer Razork pour renforcer sa jungle après une saison particulièrement décevante, conclue à l’avant-dernière place du Summer Split. De son côté, GIANTX souhaiterait associer le jungler espagnol à sa nouvelle recrue Piero, alors qu’Isma arrive lui aussi en fin de contrat. Déjà intéressée par Razork l’année dernière, l’organisation revient donc à la charge. Heretics avait également tenté de le recruter en 2025, allant jusqu’à trouver un accord avec Fnatic sur le montant du transfert, sans parvenir à convaincre le joueur.

Longtemps considéré comme l’un des piliers de Fnatic, Razork sort d’une saison 2026 compliquée. L’équipe n’a jamais réussi à retrouver sa régularité et a manqué les playoffs des Spring et Summer Splits, précipitant une nouvelle reconstruction. Malgré plusieurs finales disputées depuis son arrivée, le jungler n’aura jamais réussi à décrocher un titre de champion d’Europe avec la structure britannique.

Un départ vers Heretics pourrait notamment lui permettre de retrouver Jun, son ancien coéquipier chez Fnatic en 2024. Le support coréen avait déjà exprimé son envie de rejouer avec lui, une association que GIANTX avait elle-même envisagée lors du précédent mercato. Si une formation nord-américaine s’est également renseignée sur sa situation, la tendance serait désormais à un duel entre les deux clubs espagnols.

Razork devrait donc poursuivre sa carrière en LEC, mais son avenir reste encore à trancher. Après cinq ans chez Fnatic, le joueur de 26 ans pourrait ouvrir un nouveau chapitre de sa carrière dès 2027.

title: LOUD make VALORANT history with second Champions title
content:
LOUD beat Team Vitality 3-1 in the VALORANT Champions 2026 final, which Esports Charts reports reached 1.49 million Peak Viewers.

The win made LOUD the first team in VALORANT esports history to claim two Champions titles. The Brazilian side’s run to the trophy included a Champions final rematch against Team Vitality .

The best-of-five final finished in four maps. The 1.49 million peak was around 1.21% higher than the figure recorded for VALORANT Champions 2025, suggesting the flagship event’s top concurrent audience remained broadly steady year on year.

LOUD collected $1 million in prize money, while in-game leader Roberto “erde” Lobos was named tournament MVP. The four-map series gave the Brazilian organisation a second world championship trophy.

The audience data places the final in a period of relative stability for VALORANT’s world championship, whose first edition took place in 2021. Champions is the game’s premier annual tournament, and the 2026 final’s peak remains below the all-time high: VCT 2024: Masters Madrid is the only VALORANT event to have passed 1.6 million concurrent viewers, according to Esports Charts.

Esports Charts also ranked Champions Shanghai third among the most popular VALORANT events by peak audience. The result offers a current reach benchmark for Riot Games, participating teams and commercial partners assessing the tournament’s audience.

title: VCT EMEA : Heretics, Fnatic et BBL retenus, KOI recalé par Riot Games
content:
Les bonnes nouvelles s’enchaînent pour plusieurs organisations historiques de la scène européenne. Team Heretics a officiellement confirmé son maintien en VCT EMEA pour les deux prochaines saisons, tandis que Fnatic conservera également son statut de partenaire, selon les informations de Sheep Esports . Triple championne du VCT EMEA entre 2023 et 2025 et victorieuse des Masters Tokyo 2023, la structure britannique reste une référence malgré une saison 2026 décevante, conclue sans qualification internationale. Elle prépare d’ailleurs une importante reconstruction, avec les arrivées pressenties de marteen, Minny et ANGE1 au poste de head coach, tandis qu’Alfajer devrait rejoindre Gentle Mates. La formation turque BBL Esports fera elle aussi partie des équipes partenaires pour ce nouveau cycle.

À l’inverse, Movistar KOI ne figure pas parmi les huit organisations sélectionnées par Riot Games. Écartée du championnat fin 2025 à la suite d’un différend contractuel avec l’éditeur, la structure d’Ibai Llanos espérait pourtant retrouver sa place. En septembre, le streamer espagnol avait révélé avoir rencontré Leo Faria, responsable mondial de l’esport VALORANT, et s’être engagé à diffuser toutes les rencontres de son équipe. KOI avait même commencé à négocier avec plusieurs joueurs, mais ces démarches n’auront finalement pas suffi. Ses résultats sportifs limités lors de ses trois précédentes saisons pourraient également avoir pesé dans la balance, même si les raisons exactes de cette décision restent inconnues.

Cette non-sélection ne signifie toutefois pas que Movistar KOI est définitivement exclu du VCT EMEA. Dès 2027, Riot Games introduira un circuit plus ouvert, avec des qualifications accessibles aux équipes non partenaires et de nouvelles Cups permettant de décrocher des billets pour les compétitions internationales. Les huit organisations retenues bénéficieront néanmoins d’avantages importants, notamment une place garantie au Kickoff, un accès facilité aux Cups et des revenus liés à leur statut.

Reste désormais à savoir si Ibai tentera de relancer son projet VALORANT sans ces garanties. Une décision d’autant plus intéressante que les Masters de Valence, prévus du 5 au 20 juin 2027, offriront une vitrine exceptionnelle à la scène espagnole. Pour Heretics, Fnatic et BBL Esports, en revanche, la présence au plus haut niveau régional est assurée pour deux années supplémentaires.

title: Report: VCT 2027–2028 lists eight partners per region
content:

The report, published on October 19, 2026, said each region would have eight partner organizations, down from 10. It listed confirmed selections and reported exclusions, but its EMEA section remained a work in progress, so the visible names do not establish a complete final lineup.

The two-year cycle pairs a smaller partner pool with a format that introduces open qualifiers. Partnership status does not guarantee a place in Cups or LAN events, according to the report; selected organizations instead retain baseline revenue from Riot Games and receive in-game skins.

Non-partner teams are not necessarily leaving VALORANT. The more open circuit gives successful teams a route to qualify for international LANs and earn revenue from Riot, a change with implications for how organizations weigh established partner benefits against investment in the wider competitive ecosystem. Esports Insider has previously examined the relationship between VCT’s partnered teams and Tier 2 .

title: Global Esports Quits Valorant Weeks After First VCT Pacific Title, Releases Entire Roster

The timing makes it a shock. GE won its first VCT trophy at Pacific Stage 2 in September 2026 and played at Valorant Champions in Shanghai only weeks ago. The brand now moves on as GE Studios, a new venture built around artificial intelligence.

Sinha called it “the official last day of Global Esports as a competitive roster,”. The players can now talk to other teams.

Goodbye Global Esports #GEFought pic.twitter.com/23EpPacsMD

He also said the decision wasn’t sudden. When Riot asked partner teams about their future plans in November 2025, GE told Riot that 2026 would likely be its final year in esports.

The main reason is Riot’s new partnership deal for 2027. Sinha said that keeping the roster under the new terms would have meant running a whole organization around one team, and he didn’t think that made sense.

title: RLCS : stizzy quitte Vitality et se rapproche de NIP
content:
Le mercato européen continue de s’agiter sur Rocket League. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Ninjas in Pyjamas devrait conserver Cristian « crr » Raigal et recruter Gaspar « stizzy » Andres, dont le contrat avec Vitality est arrivé à son terme. Les deux Espagnols, considérés parmi les meilleurs représentants de leur pays, pourraient ainsi évoluer ensemble pour la première fois sur le circuit RLCS. Ils devaient initialement représenter l’Espagne lors de l’Esports Nations Cup, finalement reportée à novembre 2027.

Pour NIP, ce rapprochement marquerait le début d’une nouvelle aventure après la séparation avec son précédent trio, composé de crr, Oaly et Joreuz. Une équipe qui avait pourtant réalisé une saison 2026 solide, avec cinq qualifications en LAN internationales et une troisième place à l’Esports World Cup. Son parcours s’était néanmoins terminé sur une déception aux championnats du monde, avec une élimination dès la phase de groupes et une 13-16e place finale. Invitée au RLCS Club Championship 2027, l’organisation souhaite désormais reconstruire un effectif capable de rivaliser avec les meilleures formations européennes.

Si l’association entre crr et stizzy semble bien engagée, l’identité du troisième joueur reste encore incertaine. Joreuz était initialement pressenti pour compléter le trio, mais cette option aurait perdu du terrain ces derniers jours. Plusieurs jeunes talents sont désormais étudiés, notamment bibbaba, prozy et le Français Reyyn, spécialiste du duel en 1v1. Aucun accord n’a toutefois été annoncé pour ce dernier poste.

Le staff pourrait également accueillir un visage bien connu de la scène européenne. ViolentPanda serait en discussions avancées avec Ninjas in Pyjamas pour devenir le nouvel entraîneur de l’équipe. Libéré par Shopify Rebellion le 14 octobre, le Néerlandais connaît déjà stizzy pour l’avoir accompagné chez Dignitas lors des saisons 2024 et 2025, avec notamment une finale au Major de Raleigh. Les négociations se poursuivent, mais aucun contrat n’aurait encore été finalisé.

Après une saison encourageante chez Vitality, malgré une élimination dans le top 12 des Worlds 2026, stizzy pourrait donc rebondir rapidement aux côtés de son compatriote crr. NIP espère finaliser son nouvel effectif avant le coup d’envoi du RLCS Club Championship, prévu en décembre à Londres. Dans un mercato européen particulièrement mouvementé, le duo espagnol pourrait constituer l’une des associations à suivre en 2027.

La suite s’est révélée plus compliquée, malgré une nouvelle apparition dans le top 6 à l’Esports World Cup. L’équipe a finalement terminé sa saison sur une décevante 13e-16e place au Stage 2, précipitant une reconstruction presque totale de son projet.

Pour Desmo, ce changement d’environnement représenterait également l’occasion de rebondir. Après une expérience difficile chez Leviatán en 2025, le technicien danois avait rejoint Fnatic cette saison, sans parvenir à redresser durablement les résultats de l’organisation britannique. Malgré un top 4 encourageant au Kickoff, l’équipe a progressivement décroché, jusqu’à son élimination face à Joblife lors du Play-In du Stage 2. Desmo a néanmoins connu davantage de réussite avec la sélection danoise, qu’il a menée à la qualification pour l’Esports Nations Cup, finalement reportée à 2027.

Son arrivée chez Gentle Mates pourrait notamment lui permettre de retrouver Alfajer, avec lequel il travaillait déjà chez Fnatic. Le joueur turc fait partie des quatre recrues attendues chez M8, aux côtés de Ruxic, kozzy et Magnum. Autant de mouvements qui témoignent de l’ampleur du chantier entrepris par l’organisation française. Avec un effectif presque entièrement renouvelé et un nouveau staff en préparation, Gentle Mates semble vouloir repartir sur des bases complètement différentes en 2027. Reste désormais à officialiser ces arrivées et à connaître l’identité du dernier joueur qui viendra compléter ce projet ambitieux.

L’arrivée d’une nouvelle personnalité au sein d’un duo déjà bien établi pourrait notamment nécessiter quelques ajustements dans leur manière de jouer.

Si certains observateurs s’interrogent sur la capacité des trois joueurs à évoluer ensemble, Clix ne partage pas ces inquiétudes. Le streamer et joueur américain s’est montré particulièrement enthousiaste à l’annonce de cette association. « Je ne vois pas comment ce trio pourrait ne pas fonctionner. Les trois sont capables de s’adapter les uns aux autres » , a-t-il déclaré.

De son côté, Swizzy pourrait également retrouver une équipe de premier plan. Double champion du monde en titre, il serait désormais susceptible de rejoindre Vic0 et Malibuca, une autre association qui pourrait faire parler d’elle lors des prochaines FNCS. Cette piste reste toutefois à confirmer.

Avec Peterbot, shxrk et t3eny réunis sous les mêmes couleurs, la saison 2027 de Fortnite s’annonce déjà particulièrement intéressante. Reste à voir si ce trio parviendra à transformer son immense potentiel individuel en résultats collectifs, avec un objectif évident : décrocher le titre mondial.

title: All Prestige Icons in Modern Warfare 4 multiplayer
content:
One of the best decisions that Call of Duty has made over the past two years has been bringing back Classic Prestige, and that popular feature is back in Modern Warfare 4 . While Prestige does work a little differently this year, as there are two Prestige options for players, what hasn’t changed are the Prestige Icons that players can earn in Modern Warfare 4.

Naturally, the Prestige Icons look completely new compared to any game before MW4, but the way you earn them is the same. You enter Prestige Mode after reaching level 55 and reset your level, but you earn an icon next to your name and some other exclusive rewards. If you’re curious about the Prestige Icons, we have a complete view of what they look like in MW4, and you can see them in the guide below.

In total, there are 10 Prestige Icons that players can earn in multiplayer, along with a Prestige Master icon. We haven’t seen the Prestige Master icon just yet, but we do have a look at all 10 of the standard Prestige Icons available in MW4.

As you can see from the 10 icons, there are some clear callbacks to previous Call of Duty games represented on most of the icons. For example, Prestige 6 has the COD Ghosts logo, while Prestige 7 has the Infinite Warfare logo. We also see Prestige 5 feature the silhouette of the Modern Warfare 3 (2011) soldier logo. Prestige 10 features the “4” icon from MW4 as well, so most Infinity Ward CODs are showcased in some fashion.

It should also be noted that the individual Prestige Icons are animated. The golden figures in the middle of each icon move in unique ways, and this can be seen in-game.

While these Prestige Icons might be more monochromatic than some players might have liked, the different logos and symbols in each of the icons are nice throwbacks for Call of Duty veterans. The icons being animated is also a nice touch, as the past two years in BO6 and BO7 have featured static icons.

title: All confirmed weapons in Modern Warfare 4 so far
content:
Every Call of Duty title is built on key gameplay elements, and weapons are right at the forefront. Weapons can either make or break a game, and in Modern Warfare 4 , you’ll have access to 33 guns, launchers, and melee weapons to dispatch your enemies.

While we’ve seen a solid amount of weapons already in Modern Warfare 4, there are quite a few that have never been seen before. Luckily, we’ve rounded up every officially and unofficially revealed gun so far, giving you a complete look at the Modern Warfare 4 weapons list ahead of its release date in October.

In the multiplayer beta for Modern Warfare 4, there were over 20 weapons available to unlock and use. Of course, this doesn’t leave a lot of room for weapons at launch, given there are only around 33 expected in the game on Oct. 23. However, we already have a solid idea of what the unconfirmed weapons will be thanks to data miners going into the game files and uncovering their names and models.

The Oden is currently the only unconfirmed assault rifle we know of, but it’s been found in the game files , so it appears it’s coming to MW4 at launch. The rest of the ARs were playable in the multiplayer beta.

title: RLCS : la pépite solar débarque chez Spacestation (off.)
content:
Spacestation Gaming tient sa troisième recrue pour les RLCS 2027. L’organisation nord-américaine a annoncé la signature de Rexton « solar » M., jeune talent de 17 ans qui évoluera aux côtés de Jack « reveal » LeDuc et Zachary « zach » Stone, sous les ordres du coach André « Xpere » Ruivinho. Il prendra la place laissée vacante par le Brésilien diaz, contraint de quitter l’équipe en raison de complications administratives liées à son visa. Ce dernier est désormais pressenti chez Vitality, où il pourrait retrouver nass et Oski.

Le recrutement de solar constitue une véritable surprise. Repéré grâce à son ascension fulgurante dans les classements en ligne, l’Américain n’a encore jamais disputé de Main Event RLCS. Il a néanmoins montré des qualités prometteuses en terminant dans le Top 12 du Last Chance Qualifier nord-américain aux côtés de Druee et Kehvn. Il a également atteint la phase suisse des Opens 1v1 et 2v2 de sa région, avec deux Top 22 à la clé. Initialement attendu chez 9Lives avec monk et Juice, il a finalement choisi de rejoindre Spacestation Gaming.

Ce choix s’inscrit dans la tradition de Spacestation Gaming, réputée pour avoir révélé plusieurs jeunes talents nord-américains, notamment Daniel, Sypical et Arsenal. Mais solar devra rapidement faire ses preuves au sein d’une équipe qui sort d’une saison 2026 exceptionnelle. Après un Top 8 au Major de Paris, SSG a enchaîné deux finales internationales, à l’Esports World Cup puis aux championnats du monde RLCS, s’inclinant à chaque fois face à Team Falcons.

Avec reveal et zach comme coéquipiers, solar aura donc la lourde tâche de succéder à diaz et de maintenir Spacestation Gaming parmi les meilleures formations mondiales. Un immense défi pour un joueur de 17 ans qui s’apprête à découvrir le plus haut niveau, avec le Club Championship 2027 en ligne de mire.
